instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace font variables in `frontend/src/index.css` with Space Grotesk Variable, Playfair Display Variable, and DM Sans Variable.
2. Render a mobile-first, high-fashion, Awwwards-grade single page contact card for 'Kai Mercer' in `frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx`.

3. Implement interactive features: functional .vcf vCard file generation & download via browser Blob API; copy-to-clipboard buttons with toast notification via Sonner; interactive QR code modal for scanning; interactive Quick Inquiry drawer/dialog using Shadcn Dialog/Sheet.
4. Ensure kinetic entrance animations using `motion/react` (staggered headline reveal, button hover spring states, slow marquee ticker).
5. Provide dark theme as default with rich tactile card styling, 1px subtle white/amber borders, and crystal-clear typography hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never apply universal transition like 'transition: all' which breaks transforms.
Never center-align the app container globally.
All interactive elements must have clear focus, active and hover contrast states.
Include data-testid on all primary actions, link buttons, and modal triggers.
Use Sonner for toasts upon copying links, downloading vCards, or submitting inquiries.
